doc: State clips for the native Hunters (tools/meshy/native_states.py). src: Meshy animation-library action id (downloaded once per id by meshy_task_v9.py animate on one rig task: /home/boki/meshy/anim-native-states-1123, rig_task.txt). from/to: the source seconds kept. secs: the game's number for the state: land = content/rules/land_feel.json drop seconds by weight class (light 0.24, medium 0.30, heavy 0.50); hit = the contract's stagger dur (content/rules/warden_anim states.hit.dur 0.42); downed = HunterFall.STYLE time of the class (light 0.4, medium 0.45, heavy 0.5; the last frame holds); dash = the kit's own dash time (hunters.dash_s, from content/archetypes <arch>.dash: roll_t/time, docs/heroes/dash_interactions.md); glide = one loop. pingpong: the cut runs there and back (a loop). in_place: the hips' ground drift taken out (the game moves the body).
